title: Fixed-seed character expectation
statement: Let $\ell>0$, let $\mathbb{F}$ be the degree-$\ell$ extension of $\mathbb{F}_2$, let $\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and fix $r\in\mathbb{F}$. For uniform $s\in\mathbb{F}$, form the vector $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ whose $i$th coordinate is the dot product over $\mathbb{F}_2$ of the coordinate vectors of $r^{i+1}$ and $s$, using a fixed basis of $\mathbb{F}$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The mean of the Walsh character $(-1)^{\sum_i\gamma_i x_i}$ is $1$ if $\sum_i\gamma_i r^{i+1}=0$ in $\mathbb{F}$, and is $0$ otherwise; here each $\gamma_i$ is viewed in $\mathbb{F}$ via the natural inclusion.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is an element of the degree-$\ell$ extension field
